title: Add SHADOW XLF/FAS/FAZ leveraged-financial research
target: Market-regime research and high-volatility financial-sector opportunity detection
current: StockTracker classifies broad market regime but does not separately study leveraged financial-sector bull/bear vehicles or measure their forward outcomes.
proposed: Add XLF, FAS, and FAZ as SHADOW-only research symbols. Use XLF as the underlying financial-sector direction check, FAS as the bullish leveraged candidate, FAZ as the bearish leveraged candidate, and VIX plus the existing market regime as confirmation. Log candidate signals and 5/15/30/60-minute forward outcomes. Do not add FAS/FAZ to TRADE_SYMBOLS and do not alter paper order logic.
evidence: The user explicitly requested that FAS/FAZ be considered for volatile/uncertain market opportunities.
FAS/FAZ are leveraged directional financial-sector instruments, so using XLF as the underlying signal avoids treating leverage itself as the volatility indicator.
StockTracker already has SPY/QQQ/VIX regime context and decision-funnel instrumentation, so the leveraged-financial layer can be tested without changing execution.
risk: Low execution risk because the feature is SHADOW-only. Research risk remains high due to leveraged ETF path dependence, whipsaw, and small-sample overfitting; forward-outcome logging is included before any future execution proposal.
status_note: User explicitly authorized the SHADOW XLF/FAS/FAZ experiment in ChatGPT with 'go'.
